original_high_level_goal.name: Ensure Timely Ambulance Dispatch
original_high_level_goal.description: Allocate an available ambulance for every emergency call that can reach the scene within 11 minutes, ensuring rapid response to emergencies.

actor.name: Dispatch Operators
actor.description: Staff responsible for managing ambulance dispatch and communication.

branch_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Ensure timely and efficient ambulance response to emergency calls.
branch_001.rationale: Grounding: The parent HLG (branch_001) is directly supported by the documentation's explicit goal to allocate ambulances within 11 minutes. The reconstructed HLG is also supported as it semantically captures the core objective of timely response described in the text. Alignment: The reconstructed HLG preserves the core functional intention of ensuring timely ambulance response, which aligns with the parent's objective of rapid dispatch. Although it omits the specific 11-minute metric, it maintains the same actor perspective and high-level goal of efficient emergency handling.

original_high_level_goal.name: Ensure Accurate Tracking of Ambulance Locations
original_high_level_goal.description: To enable precise data recording and communication by dispatch operators regarding the location of ambulances, ensuring adherence to standard routes and accurate reporting of departure and destination details.

actor.name: Dispatch Operators

The reconstructed HLG accurately captures this functional intention of ensuring precise location tracking and reporting. original_high_level_goal.name: Ensure accurate communication of departure and destination details
original_high_level_goal.description: Facilitate the precise relay of location data by ambulance staff to radio operators, enabling accurate recording for effective dispatch in emergency situations.

branch_003.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Ensure accurate and timely communication of ambulance locations during emergency operations.
branch_003.rationale: Grounding: The parent HLG (branch_003) is supported as the documentation explicitly states the need for staff to 'correctly communicate departure and destination' to allow operators to record data. The reconstructed HLG is also supported as it captures the core intent of communicating location details for effective dispatch. Alignment: The reconstructed HLG preserves the core functional intention of ensuring accurate location communication by ambulance staff to radio operators for effective dispatch. While it adds 'timely' and generalizes 'departure and destination' to 'locations', the fundamental actor perspective and WHY-level objective remain aligned with the parent.

original_high_level_goal.name: Ensure timely completion of ambulance dispatch process

Alignment: The reconstructed HLG preserves the core functional intention of timely ambulance dispatching, which aligns with the parent's goal of completing the process within a maximum time limit. Although the actor is implicit in the reconstruction, the primary objective and scope remain consistent with the parent HLG.
